## Featured Projects

- [DC Operations Dashboard](https://github.com/ElioUcan/dc-dashboard): Multi-page operational dashboard for a 100 MW data center tracking uptime SLA (99.982%), PUE trends, and TIA-942 / ISO 27001 compliance across 5 views. Built with Python, Streamlit, Plotly, Docker, and deployed on AWS with Terraform IaC and GitHub Actions CI/CD.
- [ETL Pipeline: Airflow, Docker, and PostgreSQL](https://github.com/ElioUcan/airflow-etl): Daily ingestion pipeline consuming the CoinGecko REST API into PostgreSQL, with Airflow retry policies keeping failure rate under 1%. Packaged with Docker Compose.
- [Infrastructure as Code: Terraform on AWS](https://github.com/ElioUcan/terraform-aws-infra): Reproducible AWS environments (EC2 and S3) built with modular Terraform and remote state, cutting provisioning time from hours to under 10 minutes.
- [AI Agent API: Anthropic SDK and FastAPI](https://github.com/ElioUcan/ai-agent): Conversational agent with CSV reader and PostgreSQL query tools plus persistent conversation storage, served via FastAPI and deployed on AWS EC2 with Docker Compose.
- [better-readmes](https://github.com/ElioUcan/better-readmes): Open-source Claude Code skill and CLI (`npx better-readmes`) distributed via npm/npx that generates repository READMEs and populates GitHub metadata.
